headline: Ferrum find goals at Barton, keep tightest defence
dek: Ferrum had not scored before Saturday. Three different players found the net at Barton, and the one goal Ferrum conceded there is the only one they have let in all season. No other side in the conference has conceded so few.
displaced_by: Conference play opened on Sep 5; King's before-conference line is out of date, and Ferrum, goalless until Saturday, scored three at Barton with the conference's lowest goals-against.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southern Wesleyan's eleven goals have come from seven different scorers and are more than Barton, King and Ferrum have scored together, yet they have lost as often as they have won.

wire.line: Lees-McRae and Shorter are the only sides yet to drop a point.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seventeen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist on Aug 13, while no match with a published final is missing its score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: King have lost all four matches they have played, scoring three goals and conceding nine; only North Greenville are also without a point.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: North Greenville have scored in each of their three defeats, at Catawba, at home to Mars Hill and at Lander, and have yet to take a point.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jackson Bennett has kept two clean sheets for Belmont Abbey and has been beaten three times, the latest of them at Lees-McRae on Saturday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three of Shorter's seven goals belong to Joao Beer, from seven shots.

last_match.line: Lees-McRae have won every match they have played; Belmont Abbey had not lost, or conceded, since their opening day at Catawba.

next_match.line: Lees-McRae are the only side with a perfect record; Converse have lost once, at home to Wingate, and won away at King on Saturday.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
